order_item_quantity.name: order_item_quantity
order_item_quantity.value: ("order_item"."quantity" > 0 or ("order_item"."quantity" = 0 and "order_item"."original_quantity" is not null)) and ("order_item"."original_quantity" is null or "order_item"."quantity" < "order_item"."original_quantity")

order_status_history_from_status.name: order_status_history_from_status
order_status_history_from_status.value: from_status is null or from_status in ('pending', 'confirmed', 'preparing', 'ready', 'out_for_delivery', 'completed', 'cancelled')

price_list_dates.name: price_list_dates
price_list_dates.value: "price_list"."starts_at" is null or "price_list"."ends_at" is null or "price_list"."ends_at" > "price_list"."starts_at"

store_delivery_location.name: store_delivery_location
store_delivery_location.value: ("store_delivery"."location_lat" is null and "store_delivery"."location_lng" is null) or ("store_delivery"."location_lat" between -90 and 90 and "store_delivery"."location_lng" between -180 and 180)

store_delivery_service_area.name: store_delivery_service_area
store_delivery_service_area.value: service_area is null or (jsonb_typeof(service_area) = 'array' and jsonb_array_length(service_area) between 3 and 200)

store_delivery_enabled_needs_area.name: store_delivery_enabled_needs_area
store_delivery_enabled_needs_area.value: not "store_delivery"."delivery_enabled" or ("store_delivery"."location_lat" is not null and "store_delivery"."service_area" is not null)

store_delivery_rate_amounts.name: store_delivery_rate_amounts
store_delivery_rate_amounts.value: "store_delivery_rate"."base_fee_minor" >= 0 and "store_delivery_rate"."per_km_minor" >= 0 and ("store_delivery_rate"."free_above_minor" is null or "store_delivery_rate"."free_above_minor" > 0) and ("store_delivery_rate"."min_order_minor" is null or "store_delivery_rate"."min_order_minor" > 0)

store_secondary_banner_pair_left.name: store_secondary_banner_pair_left
store_secondary_banner_pair_left.value: ("store_secondary_banner_pair"."left_storage_key" is null and "store_secondary_banner_pair"."left_content_type" is null and "store_secondary_banner_pair"."left_size_bytes" is null) or ("store_secondary_banner_pair"."left_storage_key" is not null and "store_secondary_banner_pair"."left_content_type" is not null and "store_secondary_banner_pair"."left_size_bytes" > 0)

store_secondary_banner_pair_right.name: store_secondary_banner_pair_right
store_secondary_banner_pair_right.value: ("store_secondary_banner_pair"."right_storage_key" is null and "store_secondary_banner_pair"."right_content_type" is null and "store_secondary_banner_pair"."right_size_bytes" is null) or ("store_secondary_banner_pair"."right_storage_key" is not null and "store_secondary_banner_pair"."right_content_type" is not null and "store_secondary_banner_pair"."right_size_bytes" > 0)
